title: When the Witness Falls
author: Gideon Sandoval
blurb: Oscar Blackwood, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must find the witness everyone swears is dead, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
